title: Get out of their shadow
brief: The ball is switched from one #8 to the other, and their #6 slides across to screen.
briefKid: The ball goes across our midfield, and their midfielder slides over to block.
question: Your #8 has it, facing forward. Where do you go so the pass can find you?
questionKid: Your teammate has the ball, facing forward. Where can the pass reach you?

takeaway.standard: Stay on their last defender's shoulder, but slide along the line until no opponent stands between the ball and you: a striker hidden behind a defender is no option at all.
takeaway.kid: Defender between you and the ball? Slide sideways until the pass is open.

misconceptions.text: You came short toward the ball, so nobody pins their centre-backs and you run into their midfield's traffic; stay on their last line and slide along it instead.
misconceptions.textKid: Don't run back to the ball. Stay level with their last defender and slide sideways.

misconceptions.text: You stayed where the ball was before the switch, so the #8 has no pass into the striker.
misconceptions.textKid: The ball moved across. Move across with it.
